Record Class NativeHudInputs

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.raphimc.viabedrock.api.model.NativeHudInputs
public record NativeHudInputs(int context, NativeHudInputs.Kind kind, String inputs, boolean restart, int ticks) extends Record
The inputs of one native HUD scene for a frontend that confirmed the backend's UI program. The frontend resolves them with the same HUD views the backend used to choose native presentation. Empty inputs clear the kind's scene.
